evidence.scope: Read existing root-saved reports only; did not rerun or independently execute the PNG decoder.

loading.note: Runtime on-demand model readiness differed, so equal initial source counts do not certify identical final source selection.

facts.fact: The historical A1/B/A2 harness restores a new Game and creates a new Renderer/Canvas/Art per arm. Equal checkpoints/arguments are not identical renderer, Canvas, cache or GPU-context instances.

Main getContext is 2d alpha:false. Floor getContext is default 2d. resize uses layout and devicePixelRatio. No explicit 2d colorSpace/colorType/read-frequency choice exists in Renderer; actual context attributes/backing raster backend were not captured by the historical report.

Asphalt is an asynchronous Image. Its onload/onerror invalidates floorKey. Floor cache is keyed by world identity and layout/material fields. This is a real first-versus-repeated source path, but the historical harness awaited asphalt ready before drawing all arms.

The floor is a full world-sized Canvas (normal2400x1800), painted with opaque base/roads, 32%-alpha original asphalt tiles, 19000 deterministic subpixel grains and cracks/lines. It is then drawImage-composited through the ISO transform and zoom. It covers most battle background and exercises blending/resampling.

A full-screen radial vignette is rebuilt each render; cached fog is painted over the viewport; low-health/alarm/flash paths can also tint broad areas. Their values depend on explicit viewport/Game/time fields. They are actual wide-RGB paths rather than player-only pixels.

Renderer uses deterministic sin hash and explicit now/Game.time. Camera dt derives from lastNow and now, then easing/zoom/projection determines every world draw. Source search found no direct Math.random/performance.now/Date.now. The historical harness passes (frame+1)*.12, but did not serialize each renderer camera/Canvas state.

render start resets transform and paints the background; it does not reset globalAlpha, globalCompositeOperation, filter, shadow or clipping. Inspected normal world/screen/identification/minimap paths use save/restore. No concrete unbalanced normal path was identified by this audit; arbitrary external state/hidden stack cannot be excluded from source alone.

Original drawFrame saves state, applies alpha, selects high smoothing, issues the original nine-argument drawImage and restores in finally. It performs no recolour/filter/time/random operation. A changed source image/readiness can change a sprite; no documented global colour transform is introduced here.

NativePropFrames caches immutable selections keyed by object/record/image/metadata/layout identities. It does not render or modify source pixels. Renderer may choose native versus procedural fallback when asset status differs; shared ready-record identity is not proof of browser-decoded pixel equality.

Original player uses fixed256/pixelRatio1, SRGB output and NoToneMapping, two GL draws and original body/colour Canvas copies. Only a separate QA duplicate relocated the legacy read; original source remains cf5c5721. Same-context player A/B/A captures are exact in all40 samples, while the historical final whole-canvas original repeat failed.

The historical helper waits for original launch/native preparation, requires player/boss frame0, waits for asphalt ready and effect-art load, and records source readiness. All three recorded asphaltReady true. Therefore a simple unawaited asphalt onload is not established as the observed cause.

The separate cost-attempt loading abort did not produce cost frames. It is not the source of the saved completed quality arm PNG differences; those three arms reached capture and cleanup. No performance winner is inferred.

inferences.statement: The floor raw raster plus transformed main-Canvas blit and broad overlay blending can affect almost all RGB pixels. Capture original floor and main-context state/attributes on a bounded original-only repeat to separate cache-image pixels from later composition.

Camera/zoom/viewport or drawing-state differences would move/retint much of the scene. Fixed args and exact Game do not themselves prove these renderer-private fields equal; record them before/after identical original calls.

RGB-only mostly1-to2-level widespread differences with alpha unchanged are compatible with Canvas raster/blend/resampling/backend precision differences. Source and histogram do not prove a GPU-to-software transition, colour-space conversion or browser defect.

Different on-demand NPC readiness or a few native private frames can change bodies/occlusion. By itself this does not explain broad floor-region RGB changes without ROI/source evidence; no blanket exclusion is claimed.

The deferred player read is not necessary for the huge difference because the original A1-versus-original A2 comparison already fails. Its separate same-context player exact result does not certify the whole world or justify relaxing any pixel gate.

unknowns: No exact floor Canvas pixel hash/copy was stored for the failed arms.
No before/after main Canvas context attributes, transform, composite, alpha, filter, shadow or stack-sentinel proof was stored.
No same Renderer/same Game/same now original repeat has been executed in this audit.
Asphalt source URL/readiness is known, but decoded-image/backend/source-floor pixel equality across fresh instances is not proven.
Exact final native-versus-baked source selection and per-source private RGBA equality were not certified for all actors.
Colour-space/backend changes or an original renderer defect remain unresolved; do not label the failure harmless or a flake.

recommendedNextControl.first: Use one owned Renderer, original assets, one held Game/command/now with no tick/selection/camera input advance; record private state and two ordinary original renders, preserving first failure.
recommendedNextControl.then: If same-instance repeat is exact, compare fresh original instances while recording floor pixels and actual main/floor Canvas context attributes/state. If it fails, localize floor/world/screen overlay stages through separate bounded correctness captures after measurement.
rules: Do not rerun a candidate to find favourable costs.
Do not replace recorded failures, loosen strict RGBA equality, disable atmosphere/art or reduce quality for acceptance.
Correctness readbacks/diagnostics are not performance/FPS evidence.
Keep the separate loading-timeout incident separate from rendered-quality evidence.
